description: Thoughtful storage meets timeless design with the West Lake 3 Drawer Nightstand. Three dovetailed drawers with smooth glides provide convenient storage for nursery essentials — pacifiers, lotions, books, and more. The solid hardwood construction and warm Brown Maple finish match the full West Lake collection. Compact enough to fit beside a glider or crib, this nightstand is as practical as it is beautiful. Non-toxic baby-safe finish.
